description: Small cross-frontend semantic fixtures. Both sources must execute through the shared typed stack IR with identical values and output.

cases.name: conditional
cases.forth: true if 10 else 20 then

cases.name: typed-definition-and-locals
cases.forth: : subtract ( S left:int right:int -- S int ! pure ) left right - ; 10 5 subtract

cases.name: recursive-typed-definition
cases.forth: : factorial ( S n:int -- S int ! pure ) n 1 <= if 1 else n n 1 - factorial * then ; 6 factorial

cases.name: typed-closure-and-quotation
cases.forth: : add-two ( S int -- S int ! pure ) 2 + ; 5 ['] add-two execute

cases.name: immutable-map-literal-and-lookup
cases.forth: map{ s" answer" 42 s" other" 7 }map s" answer" map-get unwrap

cases.name: immutable-list-literal-and-append
cases.forth: [ 1 2 ] 3 list-append 2 list-get

cases.name: safe-list-decomposition
cases.forth: [ 4 8 ] list-uncons unwrap "head" record-get unwrap

cases.name: structured-list-match-cons
cases.forth: [ 4 8 ] list-uncons if-some "head" record-get unwrap else 0 then

cases.name: structured-list-match-empty
cases.forth: empty-list<int> list-uncons if-some drop 0 else 42 then

cases.name: explicit-typed-empty-list
cases.forth: empty-list<int> 3 list-append 0 list-get

cases.name: immutable-map-update
cases.forth: empty-map<string,int> s" answer" 42 map-set s" answer" map-get unwrap

cases.name: typed-map-entries
cases.forth: map{ "answer" 42 }map map-entries 0 list-get "value" record-get unwrap

cases.name: json-object-key-with-space
cases.forth: s"{\"first name\":\"Ada\"}" json-parse result-unwrap s"first name" json-get unwrap json-as-string unwrap

cases.name: forth-pasted-json-object-and-comma-list
cases.forth: {"first name":"Ada","age":37} "first name" json-get unwrap json-as-string unwrap

cases.name: json-object-explicit-map-normalization
cases.forth: s"{\"first name\":\"Ada\"}" json-parse result-unwrap json-as-map unwrap s"first name" map-get unwrap json-as-string unwrap

cases.name: typed-record-construction-and-projection
cases.forth: { name: "Ada" age: 37 } "age" record-get unwrap

cases.name: immutable-typed-record-update
cases.forth: { name: "Ada" age: 37 } 38 "age" record-set "age" record-get unwrap

cases.name: typed-record-destructuring
cases.forth: { name: "Ada" age: 37 } "age" record-get unwrap 5 +

cases.name: metered-loop-exit
cases.forth: begin true until 7

cases.name: named-loop-break
cases.forth: begin: done true while break done repeat s"" say

cases.name: nested-named-loop-break
cases.forth: begin: outer true while begin: inner true while break outer repeat repeat s"" say

cases.name: progressive-response
cases.forth: s"Hello " say 2 3 + int-to-string say

cases.name: forth-output-literal-shorthand
cases.forth: ." Hello from standard Forth output literal"
cases.expected_output: Hello from standard Forth output literal

cases.name: forth-explicit-line-break
cases.forth: s"first" say cr s"second" say

cases.name: progressive-computed-response-spacing
cases.forth: s"the result of 2+3 is " say 2 3 + int-to-string space str-cat say s"is that correct?" say
cases.expected_output: the result of 2+3 is 5 is that correct?

cases.name: option-projection
cases.forth: 5 some unwrap

cases.name: structured-option-match-some
cases.forth: 5 some if-some 1 + else 0 then

cases.name: structured-option-match-none
cases.forth: none if-some drop 0 else 0 then

cases.name: structured-result-match-ok
cases.forth: 5 ok if-ok drop 6 else drop 0 then

cases.name: structured-result-match-err
cases.forth: s"bad" err if-ok drop 0 else drop 3 then

cases.name: literal-boolean-match
cases.forth: true if 42 else 0 then

cases.name: literal-integer-match
cases.forth: 2 case 0 of 100 endof 2 of 42 endof otherwise 0 endcase

cases.name: symbol-data
cases.forth: 'bash

cases.name: captured-anonymous-closure
cases.forth: : add-offset ( S offset:int value:int -- S int ! pure ) value [ int -- int ! pure | offset + ] execute ; 3 39 add-offset

cases.name: closed-variant-construction
cases.forth: 42 variant<variant{none|some(int)},some>

cases.name: closed-variant-projection
cases.forth: 42 variant<variant{none|some(int)},some> variant-get<some> unwrap

cases.name: closed-variant-exhaustive-branch
cases.forth: 41 variant<variant{none|some(int)},some> variant-get<some> if-some 1 + else 0 then

cases.name: typed-result-early-propagation
cases.forth: : keep-going ( S -- S result<int,string> ! pure ) 7 ok ? drop 8 ok ; keep-going

cases.name: cooperative-producer-fiber-join
cases.forth: : producer ( S -- S int ! infer ) 3 yield 5 yield 8 ; ['] producer defer fiber-join

cases.name: raw-prose-output
cases.forth:
s"""The user said "hello".
Second line.""" say
